mapper.select: SELECT FROM bike_freight_forwarder ORDER BY name, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_freight_forwarder (name, contact_name, phone, address, remark) VALUES (#{forwarder.name}, #{forwarder.contactName}, #{forwarder.phone}, #{forwarder.address}, #{forwarder.remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_freight_forwarder SET name = #{forwarder.name}, contact_name = #{forwarder.contactName}, phone = #{forwarder.phone}, address = #{forwarder.address}, remark = #{forwarder.remark}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision}
